embedding_text: MA Digitale Medien (Digital Media) at Hochschule für Künste Bremen, a joint English-taught program with Universität Bremen combining a Media Design track and a Media Informatics track. Media Design covers media theory from a cultural-studies perspective (media history, media analysis, media philosophy with Prof. Andrea Sick), media art and media aesthetics, intermedial design, computer music (digital sound analysis, sound synthesis and processing), and smart materials for artistic production (thermochromatic colours, nitinol wires, electroluminescent surfaces). Media Informatics covers embodied interaction, entertainment computing, interactive systems, cognitive modeling, advanced computer graphics, virtual reality and physically-based simulation, massively parallel GPU algorithms with CUDA, computational geometry, information system design with UML, and IT management. Students complete a master project on a problem with societal, scientific, technological, artistic or design relevance, bridging art school and university.
